# Verity Mod for Minecraft Guide

> VerityModChecker.online is an independent Verity Mod source checker, download guide, and troubleshooting hub for Minecraft Java, Bedrock, MCPE, VERITY.exe, Groq, Ollama, and voice setup searches.

- [Minecraft Verity Mod Route](https://veritymodchecker.online/minecraft-verity-mod/): Broad-intent guide for Minecraft Verity Mod, Verity Minecraft, Minecraft Verity, the Verity Mod, Verity mods, and Verity Mod for Minecraft searches, routing users to Java, Bedrock, MCPE, MCPEDL, server, API-error, source-check, and current-versus-stale result checks by edition and file record; aliases such as `/verity-mod-for-minecraft/` and `/verity-minecraft-mod/` redirect here, while download-intent variants redirect to `/download/`.

## Current Position

July 30 Falsity update: current SERP checks show Falsity, Modrinth, commands, Bedrock Addons, and Verity/Falsity results mixed with the Verity Mod trend. `/falsity-mod/` is the FALSITY [SMILEY] source-check route for PKFL CurseForge Java Project ID `1575216`, file `FALSITY-SMILEYARCHIVE-9.0.jar`, file ID `8528006`, Forge 1.20.1, Modrinth project `r8Qz0Ic2`, version `tNOLeN6v`, SHA-1/SHA-512 hashes, MCMOBZ Bedrock Project ID `1594973`, Bedrock file `Falsity_2_0_0_Addon_updated.mcaddon`, file ID `8449365`, commands `/connectfalsity`, `/falsitysetup`, `/falsityconfig`, and the separate Survive from VERITY or FALSITY modpack Project ID `1583260`. July 30 commands update: current SERP checks show command-led demand around `verity command`, `/script debugger connect`, `/verity_language`, `/verity give_ball`, `/verity event anomaly`, `/verity status`, and video/tutorial searches. `/commands/` now exists as the command and chat-trigger map for Verity BE, PnTMC, Pocket Edition, Java, VERITY.exe, and fanmade slash-command claims. July 30 Error: No Purpose update: the official Verity BE FAQ names `Error: No Purpose` and links a support video, so `/error-no-purpose/` now exists as the exact Verity BE troubleshooting route instead of burying that intent inside the generic not-working page.

Checked July 30, 2026: Verity JE's active Modrinth project `on1Y0osD` versions list exposes `5.7.3`, `5.7.2`, and `5.6.2`; observed beta records `YLEoXe6t` for `verity-6.0.1-all.jar` and `5ech0sTo` for `verity-6.0.0.jar` now return 404. The stable Forge route is `verity-5.7.3.jar`: CurseForge record `8461257` and Modrinth version `yAt0wv1Z`, with 654.9K displayed CurseForge file downloads and 270,511 Modrinth version downloads. The older Java branch `verity-3.4.1.jar` maps to CurseForge record `8346795`, 156.0 MB, about 276.8K file downloads at check, Maven coordinate `curse.maven:verity-je-1591438:8346795`, and Minecraft 1.21.1 NeoForge; it has its own status page because exact filename searches appeared and it should not be treated as the default Java route. Current search results can mix the official file page with third-party sandbox or malware-analysis pages, so the route page explains that source identity checks and malware verdicts are separate. The current official Java loader records support Forge and NeoForge, not Fabric, so the Fabric page routes `verity mod fabric` searchers away from unsupported Fabric-profile installs. Verity BE's current file-record name is `Verity (Stable) (1.1.0)-(26.3).mcaddon`, record `8506198`, for Bedrock 26.30; the dedicated `/verity-be/` page exists because GSC showed exact `verity be` impressions with zero clicks and now also covers duplicate-package update failures reported in current player comments. The PnTMC alternate has current 3.2.0 rows for V26.30 record `8517480`, V26.20 record `8517478`, and V26.10-style record `8517473`; the July 30 MCPEDL check shows those 3.2.0 rows first, displays 7.4M listing downloads, and keeps older 3.1.0/3.0.0 rows below for old contexts. Old PnTMC 2.1.0 rows include V26.30 record `8327253`, V26.20 record `8327250`, and V26.10 record `8327242`. Verity Pocket Edition (Be) is a separate similar Bedrock listing, Project ID `1596246`, with file record `8406293`. Point-in-time CurseForge project totals are 2,355,730, 4,040,625, 7,376,299, and 57,039 downloads respectively; the Modrinth Verity JE project total is 337,756. The four tracked CurseForge Verity project pages sum to 13,829,693 displayed project downloads, while adding Modrinth gives a 14,167,449 platform-counter sum that should not be quoted as unique players. The Java vs Bedrock chooser now exists as the canonical platform-decision route for Java JAR, Bedrock MCADDON, MCPE import, PS4/Xbox host-world setup, and server/friends intent. The API route is the canonical answer for API connection failed, invalid API key, change your API key, 403, 401, 429, OpenRouter, Groq, Ollama, and Bedrock confusion; Groq and OpenRouter source checks on July 30 map 403 to permission/guardrail-style failures rather than a download problem. The Verity Minecraft map route exists because Search Console showed `verity map` impressions and live SERP checks mixed unrelated Variety maps, CurseForge galleries, videos, server wording, horror wiki results, Java mods, and Bedrock add-ons; the checked first-party records describe mods and add-ons rather than an official standalone map or world save. VERITY.exe, Verity Pack, VerityPack, VerityPack Realistic, and Ultimate VERITY are separate modpack routes; the July 30 VERITY.exe check maps SkyeTheFox Project ID `1585389`, current Forge Port 2.1.2 file record `8526843`, `VERITY.exe.zip`, 129,885 project downloads, older visible NeoForge file `8385443`, and source notes about Groq/API key, direct chat, and voice-chat setup. The July 30 Verity Pack check maps Firyx Project ID `1583377`, Sarelsana Project ID `1587394`, and felixdevytofficial realistic Project ID `1596649`, and the `verity-beta` Verity Pack result says the pack does not contain the Verity mod and must be completed separately. Ultimate VERITY is Project ID `1584643`, file record `8467605`, and its description points to an old `/minecraft/mc-mods/verity-mod` URL that currently returns 404. The site does not host files, upload selected files, collect API keys, or claim that metadata or checksum matching is a malware scan.
